description.p: Text is the word processor of grind, an office suite whose native format is OpenDocument.

It reads and writes OpenDocument Text (.odt, .fodt) files directly, against the OASIS ODF specification rather than through a translation layer. It is not a port of LibreOffice and shares no code with it.

It also opens Word documents (.docx, .docm) and Markdown files by importing them: each comes up as a new, unsaved ODF text document. It never writes a Word file, and it never makes itself the default for one.

ul.li: Headings, lists, tables and character formatting
Markdown read as it is typed: **bold** becomes bold
Spelling in seven languages, checked in all of them at once
PDF export and a print preview, on ISO 216 paper
Saves by changing as little of a file as it can, so a flat .fodt diffs line by line
